bibl.title: Magical texts from Barcelona (Montserrat Abbey and Palau Ribes collections)
bibl.seg: Raquel Martín Hernández & Sofía Torallas Tovar, Magical texts from Barcelona (Montserrat Abbey and Palau Ribes collections).
bibl.note: Edition and commentary of three papyrus fragments from the collections preserved at the Abbey of Montserrat and the Archive of the Jesuits in Barcelona, all connected to magical or divinatory practice. - 1. P. Monts. Roca Inv. 980. Activated magical text. Unknown provenance, Late Roman period. - 2. P. lit. Palau Ribes 40. A magical drawing of a scarab? Unknown provenance, Roman period? - 3. P. Monts. Roca Inv. 317. List of literary words or magical epithets? Unknown provenance, second century AD.
